name: zerodrift
description: Catch compliance, PII and sensitive-data problems in AI-written messages against your company policies before they go out. Checks Gmail sends and drafts automatically.

interface.longDescription: ZeroDrift checks drafts against your company's compliance policies before they go out. Gmail sends, drafts, draft updates and forwards are checked automatically once you trust the hooks; anything else on request. Each check returns Passed, Warned or Flagged with the flagged lines, rules and a job ID. ZeroDrift never rewrites or sends your text. Attachments, forwarded originals and saved drafts sent as-is are not checked.
capabilities: Check Gmail sends and drafts before they go out
Check a draft against your policies
